dedupe_keys.name: semantically enriched statewide building dataset based on the lower saxony 3d building model for urban planning applications

description: Semantically enriched statewide building dataset based on the Lower Saxony 3D Building Model for urban planning applications is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Abdulraheem Salaymeh (University of Applied Sciences and Arts Hildesheim/Holzminden/Göttingen). This dataset provides a semantically enriched, GIS-compatible representation of all residential buildings across the federal state of Lower Saxony, Germany. It is derived from the official statewide 3D building model (AdV-CityGML 1.0, Level of Detail 2 – LoD2), as published by the Landesamt für Geoinformation und Landesvermessung Niedersachsen (LGLN) via OpenGeoData.NI. Coverage: national (DE); the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
